name: Supply Chain Agents
description: Inventory, logistics, and demand vocabulary + starter questions (IBM ai-agents-supply-chain: continuous sense→decide→act inside guardrails).
starter_prompts: Which SKUs will hit safety-stock breach within 14 days at current demand?
Summarize inbound shipments delayed more than 3 days
Where is inventory building up against forecast demand?

terminology.description: Buffer inventory held against demand/supply variability. Breach = projected stock below it.
Projected future sales per SKU/period. This platform tracks forecast accuracy (MAE/RMSE) explicitly.
Stock Keeping Unit — the finest granularity of inventory tracking.
On-Time-In-Full delivery performance measure for inbound or outbound shipments.
Demand variability amplification moving upstream in a supply chain.
Moving stock between locations to match demand — a write action, always approval-gated.
